# Nav

Sidebar navigation: sections with optional titles, items with icon, label and a count badge; the active item on bg-emphasized.

`KenosUI.Nav` · Navigation

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Nav items={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Nav" items="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

| `items` * | `NavItem[]` |  |
